newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR HEADS INTO CHRISTMAS MOSTLY STABLE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR HEADS INTO CHRISTMAS MOSTLY STABLE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar headed into Christmas predictably stable against most major currencies, closing Tuesday's short trading session unmoved from its overnight levels.
"Nothing much happened...and so are we finishing just as we started almost all-round," one foreign exchange dealer.
"There is little business on the horizon and I would be surprised if its any different on Friday when we open again," he added.

The Zimbabwe dollar finished at its overnight level of 10.8000/8200 against lhe U.S. dollar -- the same peg at which it opened. It was also unchanged at 2.3000/3200 against the South African rand and at 6.9500/9700 against the German mark.
The local currency -- which opened Tuesday's trade slightly weaker to pound sterling at 18.1300/1800 -- ended the day at its Monday's closing rate of 18.1000/1500.
